help.inleiding: The search field searches title, category, manufacturer, series, part number, version, date, notes and source URL of every document. Technical identification (document ID, i18n key and source path) is not searched — use the filter dropdowns for that.
help.basis_tekst: Type one or more words. All words must be present (AND). Search is case-insensitive. Leading and trailing spaces are ignored.
help.operatoren:
spaceAND — all terms must match
,AND — same as space
|OR — at least one term matches
-exact word — term must appear as a standalone word
!exclude — term must not appear
%wildcard — one or more characters
help.uitsluiten_tekst: The exclamation mark (!) excludes any word that contains the search text. So !esr also excludes mesr. If you want to exclude only the standalone word, that is not yet possible in this version.
help.voorbeelden:
esrdocuments with 'esr' in title or metadata
esr meter'esr' AND 'meter'
esr,metersame as above
esr|lcr'esr' OR 'lcr'
%meterends with 'meter'
!lcrwithout 'lcr'
esr !lcr'esr' but not 'lcr'
-esr'esr' as a standalone word
help.tips: Start broad and refine. An empty search field shows everything. Combine the search field with the category and tool dropdown filters to narrow further.
help.filters_tekst: The search field searches human-readable metadata. The filter dropdowns (category, tool) filter on structured context. Both work together.
